rationale: Contextual lexical correction after individual image review of Manas2010 PDF1047. Yudakhin2015 кайкы I2 quotes маңдай сөөгү кайкы экен, бу Каныкей баламдын көрөр күнү тайкы эле and explains Kanykei unfortunate fate/hard life ahead. Its separate тайкы entry does give little life remaining for күн көрөрү тайкы; that was the earlier rendering basis. The paired forehead/fate formula and forecast of unsupported flight/suffering here favor the exact Kanykei hardship example, rather than a definite short lifespan. Source wording and IDs unchanged; no specialist review.

changes.before: Your forehead slopes rather low and back;
changes.after: Ill fortune is written on your brow;

changes.before: Your remaining days of life are few,
changes.after: A hard life lies ahead of you,
